summary:
Fixed the nil pointer in [config.go](/app/config.go:45). When metrics are enabled but the `metrics` config block is absent, `LoadConfig` now supplies default metrics settings instead of letting `/status` dereference `nil`.

Verification passed:

```text
./test.sh
PASS: Server starts and responds correctly with metrics enabled
```

Note: `test.sh` rebuilds the tracked `server` binary, so `git status` shows `server` modified in addition to `config.go`.
